title: Olive's Rainy-Day Box
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, ow, oi, ear added, 47-sound stage.

pages.brief: Olive the grey owl standing at the edge of a garden hedge.
Olive the owl peering into the hedge, a small wooden box held in one claw.
Olive the owl picking up a small round coin from among the hedge leaves.
Olive the owl picking up a small curled snail shell shaped like a horn from the hedge.
Olive the owl picking up a second, pale shell from under the hedge.
Dark clouds gathering above the hedge, the first drops just starting to fall.
Olive the owl setting the wooden box down safely in a dry gap under the hedge.
Olive the owl sitting contentedly under the hedge beside the full wooden box, rain falling outside.
